name: live-indicator
title: LiveIndicator
description: Pink dot and label that marks a real-time stream. Not a status.

a11y.pattern: Static <span> with a decorative dot and visible label
aria: paused swaps the dot for a pause glyph and writes the word "paused" (pausedLabel must contain it too)
Dot pulse stops under reduced motion; pulse=false (data-pulse="false") also disables the animation
variant="dot" shows the dot alone: the label stays in the DOM in a .sr-only span, so it is still read; write a label that makes sense where it is read ("live")
a11y.notes: Pair it with a Pause control for streams (RGAA 13.8). Never show it for a finished result.
